body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea HAWKING RADIATION, the black hole evaporating: satin light-grey tubes leave the lens rim and flow left over front and top; the further from the horizon, the more each tube breaks into a chain of beads shrinking from 6 to 2 mm. The beads work: a dense pearl field on the front-left grip for two fingertips, a bead chain over the top shrinking toward the shutter to lead the index finger into a beaded collar, two clear pearls on top as charge light pipes, gaps between bottom beads as vents, a pearl loop at the top-left corner as strap eyelet, a flattened pearl cluster on the back as thumb rest. image[2] = tube paths flowing into a lens. image[3] = bright ring round a black void, for the lens rim. image[4] = knurled pads and red marks. Matte black core, red index dot, sliding back door. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
